name: Webflow
description: Webflow MCP lets AI tools design pages, manage CMS content. Browse and update collections, create and edit pages, modify layouts and styles, and automate site-level tasks through natural language prompts. Bring Webflow into your AI workflow with a structured, secure interface that translates AI actions into real changes across your site—helping teams build, update, and scale Webflow projects faster with less manual work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Webflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Webflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.webflow.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Webflow MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Webflow scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Webflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Webflow in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Webflow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Webflow failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Webflow scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Webflow is developed by Webflow. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
